«+ Candidata» agrega un sitio que visita: “+ Candidate” adds a site you scouted or will scout: photos, address, map link, who grants permission, their phone, the cost per day and notes (light, noise, access…).
«+ Candidato» agrega a cada actor o actr: “+ Candidate” adds each actor who auditions: photos, age, contact, agency, the link to their audition and your notes. Status goes from called in to callback (or passed).
«+ Escena» agrega una escena que aún no: “+ Scene” adds a scene that isn't in the script yet (with a dotted border). Drag it into place and, when you're ready to write it, “Send to script” creates its scene heading right there.
«+ Toma» anota una toma nueva con la hor: “+ Take” logs a new take with the time and the card in camera. Tap a take to mark it NG, OK or Print and add a note.
«Añadir música» pone una pista para medi: “Add music” adds a track to judge the pacing against. It's saved only on this computer.
«Elegir esta locación» la deja como la l: “Choose this location” sets it as the location of those scenes in the shooting schedule, with its address; from there it goes to the call sheet.
«Elegir para el papel» lo deja como acto: “Cast in role” sets them as the character’s actor on the call sheet, with their phone, unless you’ve already written another name there.
«Meses» muestra hojas de mes, como un ca: “Months” shows month sheets, like a wall calendar, with the tasks and the shoot as colored bars; “Timeline” shows each task as a bar across the days, by phase; “Board” shows cards in columns, by phase or by status (to do, in progress, done).
